verdict.rationale: Codex cloud lets users delegate longer tasks to an isolated cloud environment, run/test with configured repo tooling, and returns a summary/diff for review or PR creation—covering build, test, and demo-for-review end-to-end. Community evidence corroborates real agentic task completion (e.g., fixing issues in minutes) though also notes speed/quality variability. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on case study specifically showing a full build+test+demo cycle in cloud mode, and some community reports of inconsistent agentic reliability.
